name: smwgraphics-bumper
title: Bumper
description:
Here are some new graphics for Blind Devil's custom Bumper sprite which you can find here (until it's approved): https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=section&a=details&id=17879

The graphics are a scaled down version of the bumper found in Super Mario Maker for Wii U.

I have included 6 different palettes to use with these graphics. The Pink one is the default pink used in SMM.
